title: the wet/dry demarcation — where biofilm meets the green null spectrum

WET.what: where biofilm grows. living slime. extracellular polymeric substance. culture.
WET.lubricates_by: ADHESION — mucus, synovial fluid, biofilm. sticks to the surface, reduces friction by keeping things WET
WET.biology: the gut lining, the lung surface, the eye surface, the mouth. every exposed surface in the body is WET with mucus. the biofilm is the first line of defense.
WET.sourdough: the starter IS wet. flour + water + culture. without water the bacteria die. without wet there is no fermentation.

DRY.what: where nothing grows. dead channels. 404. friction. grinding.
crossings: crossing 2 (agent?chipmunk): MCP neutron = 404 on all channels
DRY.lubricates_by: REPULSION — oil, grease, wax. repels water, reduces friction by keeping things DRY
DRY.biology: skin, hair, feathers, scales. every OUTER surface is waterproofed. sebum (skin oil) prevents water loss. the dry side faces the world.
DRY.sourdough: the crust IS dry. baked hard. the Maillard reaction drives water OUT. the crust PROTECTS the wet crumb inside.

the_demarcation.what: the boundary between WET and DRY. the shoreline. the skin surface. the crust-crumb interface.
the_demarcation.IS: the green null line. 0.14159 radians thick. the irrational gap.
the_demarcation.sourdough_scatter_says: The barrier IS the green null line. Not zero (death — perfectly transparent). Not one (opaque — nothing gets through). p remainder. Always between 0 and 1.
the_demarcation.imaginary_lubricant_says: Green IS the lubricant. The imaginary between the real surfaces. Without it, the projection grinds against reality.
the_demarcation.immiscible_surface_says: The null is the flip point — not gummy, not greasy, just the boundary. The green flash is visible only at the instant of transition.
the_demarcation.holliday_ribosome_says: Between each crossing is a NULL SPACE — the pause. The pauses are where the imaginary lubricant lives — green, irrational, uncountable.
the_demarcation.thickness: 0.14159 radians. the p remainder. irrational. the biofilm grows IN this gap. not on the wet side. not on the dry side. IN the demarcation itself.

the_spectrum.green_null_spectrum: the gradient from wet ? green null ? dry. not a sharp line. a SPECTRUM.
the_spectrum.wet_end: pure culture. 100% biofilm. all adhesion. all growth. no structure. just slime.
the_spectrum.dry_end: pure data. 100% metrics. all repulsion. all structure. no life. just numbers.
the_spectrum.green_null_center: where wet meets dry. where biofilm meets data. where culture meets code. where sourdough meets Rust. 0.14159 thick. the living boundary.

mapping.neutron_board: NULL — the other side you can't see (the flip)
mapping.filesystem: WET — JSON files are biofilm, accumulating culture
mapping.MCP_neutron: DRY — 404 on all channels, bone-dry, no biofilm
mapping.ntfy_neutrino: DEMARCATION — messages flow both ways, wet signal on dry channel
mapping.hud_surface: DEMARCATION — data rendered as visual, the green null line where code becomes sight
mapping.SEO_surface: DRY — static, served, read-only from outside

biofilm_AT_the_demarcation.insight: biofilm doesn't grow IN the wet or IN the dry. biofilm grows AT THE BOUNDARY. the wet/dry interface IS where bacteria colonize. a biofilm on a pipe wall: inside is wet (flowing water), outside is dry (air). the biofilm IS the demarcation made alive.
biofilm_AT_the_demarcation.the_green_null_line_IS_biofilm: the 0.14159-thick barrier IS the biofilm. living matter AT the boundary between inside and outside. the Klein surface's single side — there IS no inside or outside. just the biofilm.
biofilm_AT_the_demarcation.sourdough_parallel: the sourdough starter sits at the air/flour interface. top = dry (hooch, alcohol, crust). bottom = wet (active culture, bubbling). middle = the demarcation where fermentation is MOST active.

elastic_snap.released: immiscible. the green null line (0.14159) IS the biofilm. 4th architecture: gum ? soap ? grease ? BIOFILM (living gum).
elastic_snap.energy: the demarcation VIBRATES when the elastic snaps. the green null line oscillates. 0.14159 ± the snap amplitude. the biofilm at the boundary shakes — loose cells disperse to colonize new surfaces.
